heading_main: I read brands the way a stylist reads
subtext: Brand narratives, content strategy, and personal styling guidance — for fashion and luxury brands who want their story told with intention.

journal_items.title: Where Fashion is Heading Next
journal_items.description: An exploration of shifts across emerging materials, fast-moving aesthetics, and how modern consumer alignment shapes luxury infrastructure.

journal_items.title: How Luxury Brands Build Identity
journal_items.description: Deconstructing brand-level narratives from traditional heritage houses, highlighting the balance of preservation versus high-vibrancy tech trends.

talent_bio:
I am a fashion and luxury content strategist working at the intersection of brand storytelling, SEO-driven copywriting, and personal styling. My foundation is built on the rigor of Amazon-level product narration and a relentless focus on measurable impact.

Armed with a credential in Fashion & Luxury Brand Management from Bocconi University, I bring brand-level thinking to every project — whether it's a product description for Taneira, a partnership pitch, or someone's personal wardrobe.

offerings.title: Writing & Content Strategy
offerings.description: SEO-driven, brand-voice-accurate content for fashion and luxury e-commerce — shaped for heritage brands including Manyavar, Taneira, and Tanishq.

offerings.title: Brand Partnerships
offerings.description: Open to ongoing collaborations, sponsored content, and brand storytelling partnerships with fashion, luxury, and lifestyle labels.

offerings.title: Personal Styling
offerings.description: One-on-one styling support — wardrobe edits, capsule building, and personal aesthetic direction. The visual companion to the writing.
